releaseNotes:
📷 Reliable WhatsApp Photo Saving & 👤 Unified Instagram Senders (v1.2.9):
• 👤 Unified Instagram Chats: Fixed duplicate entries where messages were saved under 'Instagram' and the username. All Instagram chats are now strictly and cleanly unified under the contact's username.
• 📷 Bulletproof WhatsApp Photos: Upgraded media pipeline with ContentResolver direct streaming (Scoped Storage proof on Android 10-15+), direct notification photo capture, live MediaStore ContentObserver, and extended progressive background download scans.
• 🛡️ Auto-Healing: Legacy 'Instagram' placeholder conversations automatically heal and merge into the sender's thread on launch.
